freshness_caveat: Coal (202 days stale, as of 2025-12-26) and Clean Dark (197 days stale, as of 2025-12-31) metrics outdated; fuel-switch merit-order assumption and coal-to-gas spread widening may not reflect current front pricing. Merit-order narrative relies on fresh Clean Spark (95th-percentile) and DE Power (84th-percentile) data (as of 2026-07-16).
risk_flags: GB Power 97th-percentile (142.45 EUR/MWh) with French nuclear shut by heat — further outages or prolonged recovery could extend premium 5–10pp.
EU storage 52.77% full, 15 pp below seasonal — refill pace through Aug-Sep will set H2 thermal call and winter curve shape.
TTF extended 2.2σ above 50d trend at 54.35 EUR/MWh; Strait of Hormuz unresolved and Russia diesel export halt tighten LNG arb and import scarcity.
Coal data stale (202 days old); Clean Dark stale (197 days old) — merit-order assumption on fuel switch may not reflect current front pricing.

base.summary: Heat-strained French nuclear persists; TTF holds extended 2.2σ; GB premium stable at 95th-percentile; storage refill modest.

downside.summary: France restores 2–3 GW nuclear by end-week; Hormuz stabilizes; record US LNG eases arb; renewable share rebounds; thermal call softens.

upside.summary: France reactor restart delayed; Hormuz escalates further; EU sanctions vote triggers Brent spike >5 USD/bbl; fuel switch to gas accelerates.

themes: Nuclear scarcity and heat-driven outages tighten GB-EU power spreads
Geopolitical risk on crude, LNG, and diesel supply lifts thermal fuel switching
Storage deficit and TTF extension widen call on gas-dependent generation
Coal historically cheap but out of merit; fossil dispatch regime inverted
top_drivers: French nuclear heat-shutdown supply loss (GW-scale outage) forces gas/power displacement and widens GB-DE spread to 97th-percentile.
Strait of Hormuz disruption and Russia diesel export collapse tighten global LNG and refined-product arb; TTF extends 2.2σ above trend on scarcity premium.
EU storage 15 pp below seasonal and renewable share -15% w/w amplifies thermal baseload call; Clean Spark 95th-percentile reflects sustained coal-to-gas merit-order flip.
Oil price cap sanctions delay (vote end-July) creates Brent upside tail; crude +5–8 USD/bbl scenario would cement fuel-switch advantage to gas generation.
top_takeaway: GB Power at 97th-percentile amid French nuclear outages and Hormuz disruption; Clean Spark 95th-percentile signals extended thermal dispatch; storage 15 pp below seasonal risks H2 refill.

watchlist.why: Heat-driven shutdowns directly drive GB-DE power premium; each week of outage tightens generation supply 2–3 GW and sustains 5–15 EUR/MWh power uplift.
End-July ratchet delay risks Brent spike; crude +5–8 USD/bbl feeds fuel-switching margin and TTF arb tightness via refined-product scarcity.
Ongoing disruption constrains global LNG supply; resolution or further closure will move Brent ±5–10 USD/bbl and EU LNG premiums ±2–4 EUR/MWh.

watchlist.metric: Russia diesel export halt impact on industrial demand
watchlist.why: Refined-product scarcity can drive industrial fuel switching to gas; temporary lift to clean-dark spread and TTF gas-on-coal edge.
Drop from 44% to near seasonal lows increases thermal call; if wind and solar remain suppressed, thermal merit-order tightening persists into Aug.
